notes:
【新增功能】
- 新增「智能抠图」功能：支持一键批量去除背景并导出透明 PNG / WebP，首次使用按需下载离线 AI 模型，永久本地运行、保护隐私。
- 新增「外观切换」功能：支持「自动（跟随系统）」、「黑色」、「白色」三种外观模式自由切换。
- 新增序列帧「抽帧」功能与内存帧缓存，切换预览零闪烁。
- 压缩质量支持手动输入精确百分比，也可使用方向键微调。
- 完善在线自动更新：支持国内镜像加速下载、后台定期检查、稍后提醒和取消下载。
- 完善 Windows 适配及在线升级支持。

【体验与视觉优化】
- 全新深浅双色界面升级，焕新 `#60FF44` 主题色、毛玻璃底部操作栏、窗口外框细节、面板分割线与图标视觉。
- 升级大图对比预览体验：执行后点开预览 0 秒瞬开，执行前预览结果自动缓存并在正式执行时直接复用，无需重复计算。
- 优化抠图透明边缘噪点清理与无损体积压缩，精简抠图列表与设置面板信息展示。
- 统一各模式执行按钮样式与全局鼠标光标交互细节。

[New Features]
- AI Cutout: One-click batch background removal with transparent PNG / WebP export. Downloads the offline AI model on demand and runs 100% locally for privacy.
- Appearance Switcher: Switch freely between Auto (Follow System), Dark, and Light modes.
- Frame Extraction & Memory Cache: Extract every Nth frame in sequence mode with flicker-free preview playback.
- Precise Quality Input: Type exact quality percentages or fine-tune with arrow keys.
- Enhanced Auto-Updater: Mirror acceleration, periodic background checks, remind-me-later, and download cancellation.
- Improved Windows adaptation and online update support.

[Improvements & Visual Polish]
- All-new Light & Dark UI with `#60FF44` brand accent, frosted-glass bottom action bar, refined window borders, dividers, and icons.
- Instant Before/After Preview: 0-second preview opening after execution; pre-execution previews are cached and reused directly during batch runs.
- Cleaner AI cutout transparent edges and lossless size optimization, with a streamlined file list and settings panel.
- Unified action button styles and cursor interactions across all modes.
